content.comment_body: I am an Electrical Instructor working with apprentices and setting up a test rig. I have a [product_name] controller but can't download the [product_name] software ([version_no]). Can anyone assist?

A licensed version of [product_name] software isn't available for direct download, only upgrade packages can be downloaded. Upgrades require an existing licensed installation on your computer. If you don't already have [product_name] software installed, you'll need to purchase the installation media (DVD).

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to obtain the necessary [product_name] software ([version_no]) due to [company_name]'s licensing and distribution rules, which permit only upgrades to be downloaded, not the initial licensed installation. This creates difficulties for educational setups when installation media is not readily available.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to directly download and install the [product_name] software ([version_no]) for use in their educational test rig, without facing restrictive access or licensing barriers.
